about:
# GDLite

This just reskins the game to resemble old versions of GD Lite.
changelog:
# 1.4.0
- Fixed problems with code. (i was making 4 MenuLayer hooks...)
- Had to remove GDLite watermark due to a crash I couldn't figure out how to fix.
- ANNIHILATED HEROBRINE
- Removed leftover resources from older updates.

# 1.3.3
- iOS support back again!

# 1.3.2
- 2.2074 support
- removed herobrine
- mac support

# 1.3.0
- 2.206 support
- fixed issue where the "lite" text appears on the loading screen regardless whether its disabled or not
- added herobrine

# 1.2.2
- ios support

# 1.2.1
- Change GDLite watermark position
- Removed "Hide GDLite watermark" option. can be hiden by setting GDLite watermark position to 0.

# 1.2.0
- Ability to remove More games menu modification (to fix compatibility with other mods)
- Android32 support

# 1.1.0
- Ability to hide the "lite" subtext.
- Ability to remove the "GDLite. Free Trial" watermark from PlayLayer
- Android64 support

# 1.0.0
- Inital Release
